rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately changing something’s appearance, condition, nature, or function.

example.english: This design can transform the feel of the whole house.
example.traditional: 呢個設計可以改變成間屋嘅感覺。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 ho2 ji5 goi2 bin3 sing4 gaan1 uk1 ge3 gam2 gok3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing what the thing becomes, especially in patterns like 將 A 變成 B.

example.english: We can transform the old warehouse into a studio.
example.traditional: 我哋可以將舊貨倉變成工作室。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 gau6 fo3 cong1 bin3 sing4 gung1 zok3 sat1

rows.note: Use this for something undergoing a change in appearance or character, often with 咗 or 緊.

example.english: After the renovation, the room will transform and look much nicer.
example.traditional: 裝修完之後，間房會變靚好多。
example.jyutping: zong1 sau1 jyun4 zi1 hau6 gaan1 fong2 wui5 bin3 leng3 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for converting something from one form or format into another, especially in technical or practical contexts.

example.english: You can transform the file into another format.
example.traditional: 你可以將個檔案轉換成另一種格式。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 go3 dong2 on3 zyun2 wun6 sing4 ling6 jat1 zung2 gaak3 sik1
